# Town Meeting & Election

  1. Town Caucus

At the Caucus, prospective candidates for the various town elective offices are nominated to be placed on the ballot for the Annual Town Election, held in May each year.

  2. Town Election

The Town Election is the first article of business at the Annual Town Meeting. The Town Election is normally held on the first or 2nd Saturday in May at the Town Hall Auditorium. Voting hours are from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.

  3. Town Meeting Procedure

The Town Meeting is the legislative body of Weston's town government and all spending, changes in the town bylaws, and zoning bylaws must be approved by Weston voters in attendance.

  4. Town Meeting Votes

View votes from Town Meetings dating back to 2006.

# Town Clerk

Weston's Town Clerk is appointed by the Select Board. The Town Clerk’s Office is the custodian of the official records and documents of the Town, issues dog licenses, marriage licenses, business certificates, and conducts the annual Town Census. The Town Clerk’s Office also registers all voters and conducts elections in strict conformance with state law.

  1. Annual Town Census

The annual Town Census is mailed to all Weston residents at the beginning of the year and is an important document that must be filed in order to obtain certain Town services, as well as to remain active in the voter registration roll.

  2. Board of Registrars of Voters

As required by Massachusetts General Law, a Board of Registrars of Voters consisting of the Town Clerk and 3 other persons are appointed by the selectmen for the term of 3 years.

  3. Elected State & Federal Representatives

View the elected officials on the state and federal level for the Town of Weston.

  4. Licenses & Certificates

Information on obtaining marriage or dog licenses and business certificates or copies of certificates.

  5. Public Records Request

The Massachusetts Public Records Law provides that every person has a right of access to public information.This right of access includes the right to inspect, copy or have copies of records provided.

  6. Raffle Permit (PDF)

Fill out the application for permit to conduct temporary business.

  7. Town Meeting & Election

Learn how to participate in Town Meeting

  8. Voting

Find out about voting in the Town of Weston.
